name: Manacapuru
source: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb web service
datum: cm above the local staff gauge zero (ANA does not publish the zero's elevation in this service)
license: No license on the HidroWeb service itself. The SNIRH metadata record for the national hydrometric network allows reproduction of the data provided the source is cited (https://metadados.snirh.gov.br/geonetwork/srv/api/records/f85dbf06-a869-414c-afc5-bb01869e9156). Credit: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb.
notes: Datum check: 485 days where both the historic series and telemetry have a value (2025-01-01 to 2026-04-30); telemetry daily mean minus historic value: median +0.0 cm, mean -0.4 cm, 5th-95th percentile -7.4 to +5.4 cm. A median near zero means the two share the same gauge zero.

Historic series: ANA HidroSerieHistorica, tipoDados=1 (stage). Where a month exists at consistency level 2 (consistent, reviewed by ANA) we use it; otherwise level 1 (raw) and mark it provisional. Last level-2 date: 2023-12-31. Level-1 days used: 852.

Per-day status codes from ANA (CotaNNStatus): 724 days flagged 2 'estimated' are marked estimated; 4 days flagged 3 'doubtful' and 0 days flagged 4 'dry staff gauge' are kept as published with their consistency-level quality.

Daily value: ANA's daily-mean row where published (normally the mean of the 07:00 and 17:00 staff readings); otherwise the mean of the reading rows for that day. Days by source row: {'daily_mean_row': 19791}.

Historic record ends 2026-04-30. Days after that come from the ANA telemetry feed (DadosHidrometeorologicos, mostly 15-minute readings), averaged to a daily mean (164 days, marked provisional). Telemetry days with fewer than 12 readings: 0. Dropped as partial days (fewer than 75% of the readings the gauge usually sends per day, the median over the 61 days around it): 9, most recent 2026-10-16, 2026-10-17, 2026-10-18, 2026-10-19, 2026-10-20.
No fill values found in this series; ANA leaves missing days blank.

measurement_history.fact: ANA inventory: staff gauge readings start 1972-06-01 and continue. Operator SGB-CPRM. No recorder listed.
Data check: ANA flags 13% of days in the 1990s as estimated, the highest share of any decade at this gauge.
measurement_history.source: derived from ANA HidroSerieHistorica status codes, station 14100000

measurement_history.fact: Not found: number and hour of daily readings, gauge moves, gauge zero history, any publisher statement on early accuracy.

public_notes: This record starts in 1972. About one day in eight in the 1990s was estimated by Brazil's water agency rather than read, and values after 2023 are not yet reviewed.
